question: Should this maintainer-owned umbrella remain the canonical coordinator for the three Wave 1 type-contract cleanup PRs until those PRs land or are descoped?
rationale: The issue is protected, assigned, and already paired with three open implementation PRs, so automation should not close or replace the coordination item without maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue the three-slice wave
options.body: Keep the umbrella open while maintainers review the plugin-registry, script-declaration, and gateway-client PRs as separate slices.

options.title: Narrow after partial landing
options.body: After any PRs land, update the issue body or title so it tracks only the unresolved slice.

options.title: Defer the wave
options.body: Pause or close the linked PRs and leave the internal type-contract consolidation for a later maintainer-owned refactor wave.

recommendation.title: Continue the three-slice wave
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella open while maintainers review the plugin-registry, script-declaration, and gateway-client PRs as separate slices.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the umbrella and opened all three current implementation PRs.
